name: Dusk
overview: Dusk uses a slash attack that can hit through Protect from Melee, with the damage dealt being reduced by 80%.

During the final phase of the battle, Dusk has a 1/6 chance each attack to alternate attack styles; that is to say to switch from melee to Ranged or vice versa. However, using the correct protection prayer will increase this chance to 1/3 per attack. For the first attack at the start of the phase, there is a 2/3 chance Dusk will use the opposite attack style of the one the player is praying against.

Dusk's Ranged attack, which consists of two orbs being fired at the player in succession, has a unique form of damage calculation during this phase. If Dusk succeeds the Ranged accuracy check, the first orb will always hit for 60% of his max hit, or half of that number if the player is praying correctly. The second orb meanwhile will carry out a random damage roll upon succeeding the accuracy check, yet goes on to make a second damage roll ranging between 0 and the damage value rolled directly prior.
